displayName: Research any company before a key meeting
summary: Walk into any pitch, partnership, or sales meeting with a full briefing ready.

useCases.title: Research any company before a key meeting
useCases.message: Help me prepare for an important meeting. Ask me which company I am meeting and what the context is: investor pitch, partnership, client meeting, or something else. Then research their product, team, recent news, and the specific people I will be speaking with. You might want to check if we have had any prior email contact or intros. Give me a tight briefing I can review before the call.
